column1: # Decision 0022's acceptance values for the word intrinsics, hand-computed
# from the decision's own statements (MIN = -2147483648, MAX = 2147483647).
#   id      unique; names the case in output
#   width   the body's Integer width: 32, or 64 (the host's, as an int64 body)
#   args    comma-separated arguments, in order, passed at run time
#   value   the expected result for ok; `-` otherwise
# Every ok case is listed at both widths: a 64-bit body computes the same
# answers as the board's 32-bit one. The operand-range cases are at 64 only:
# there an out-of-i32 operand reaches the intrinsic at run time, which is the
# guard under test, not a 32-bit literal's refusal at parse time.
